description:
## Empirical anchor

2026-05-18 multi-arc autonomous sequence (Arcs 39+40+41) priming established polling-cron-at-PLINY for cross-tier bw-signal dispatch. This departs from MAJOR_PLINY.md §6.2 "no cron by default; surface-and-wait" — operationally adopted to enable zero-paste dispatching across the multi-arc engagement.

The pattern HELD CLEANLY across all 3 arcs:
- 3 arcs picked up dispatch signals via polling cron with no PRINCIPAL paste touchpoints
- Cross-tier `[for:]` signal routing scaled through all 3 arc cycles
- Per-arc triple-attestation (PLINY + user-tier-polybius + POLYBIUS_the_stoa) held end-to-end
- Wall-clock pace: ~30 min average per arc; 3 arcs in ~90 min
- Sequence-end: 2 §25 PRINCIPAL-gates correctly routed cross-tier in ~4 min round-trip each

This is the proto-canon-promotion evidence for amending §6.2 to allow PLINY-side polling-cron for multi-arc autonomous engagements.

## Fix shape

Amend MAJOR_PLINY.md §6.2 to recognize a third mode beyond "surface-and-wait":
- **Default mode (preserve)**: no cron; surface-and-wait. The right default for single-arc dispatches + first-contact engagements + when PRINCIPAL is actively driving.
- **Multi-arc autonomous mode (NEW)**: polling cron permitted when PRINCIPAL has explicitly delegated multi-arc engagement to user-tier (e.g., priming-paste establishing the engagement). Cron monitors bw for `[for: pliny-the-stoa]` dispatch signals on a named coordination ticket. Same hygiene as POLYBIUS_the_stoa polling per §7.2 + §11 step 1.5 renewal.
- **Standby mode (existing precedent)**: between arcs in a multi-arc engagement, polling cron remains active but PLINY is idle awaiting next dispatch. Auto-acknowledges routine heartbeats; engages on substance.

Document the per-mode hygiene + canonify the priming-paste pattern for establishing multi-arc engagements.

## Sequencing

P3. Arc 42+. Substrate-canon edit (MAJOR_PLINY.md §6.2 amendment + possibly op-disc §7.2 cross-ref). Pairs naturally with the §5.11-extension ticket (both are bbi-thesis-evidence-driven substrate-canon refinements surfaced by the Arcs 39+40+41 sequence experience).

## Cross-references

- HUMAN_paste-pliny-the-stoa-priming.md @ d7fdd5d — the priming paste that established the pattern
- stoa--utn — the coordination ticket the polling cron monitored across 3 arcs
- stoa--bbi — refined-principle thesis evidence (3-arc empirical confirmation that the pattern works)
- Sequence ships: f1f222a (Arc 39) / dbb5b81 (Arc 40) / 6b6fb11 (Arc 41) — all under the polling-cron-as-PLINY-default operational model
title: Amend MAJOR_PLINY.md §6.2 to permit polling-cron for multi-arc autonomous engagements (Arcs 39-41 proto-canon evidence)
